product.name: AutoCost
product.description: A construction cost estimation tool providing live, region-specific pricing for materials and labor, including local stock levels, to create accurate and up-to-date estimates.

product.name: Assemblies & Templates
product.description: Pre-built construction templates grouping materials, labor, and profit margins into reusable blocks to speed up estimating and project planning.

product.name: Construction Estimating Software
product.description: A software platform that automates the creation of detailed and accurate construction estimates using templates, live pricing, and integrated project data.

product.name: General Contractor Software
product.description: An integrated platform for general contractors combining estimating, project management, scheduling, client communication, and financial tools.

product.name: Payments & Invoicing
product.description: A payment processing and invoicing system that automates billing, sends payment requests, and enables instant settlement into business accounts.

product.name: Business Accounts
product.description: Financial accounts designed for construction businesses to manage payments, track transactions, and simplify financial reporting.
